city.name: Nagasaki
city.intro: A port town that was open to trade with Portuguese and Dutch ships for centuries. Castella and glass-blowing shops, sweets and coffee by the stone bridges of the Nakashima River, and the slope below Glover Garden: Rin's picks.
city.introJa: 南蛮貿易と和蘭貿易の時代から、海の向こうへ開いていた港町。カステラとびいどろの店、中島川の石橋のまわりの菓子と珈琲、グラバー園の坂の下の店を、凛のおすすめで。

locator.en: In Nagasaki, on Kyushu · around the harbour, on hillsides
locator.ja: 九州の長崎県・長崎港をとりまく坂の町

industries.ja: 長崎カステラ・南蛮菓子
industries.about: Castella is said to come from the sweets that arrived with the Nanban trade. In Nagasaki small shops still bake it. Iwanaga Baijuken, open since 1830, bakes its castella and then rests it overnight.
industries.aboutJa: カステラは、南蛮貿易で伝わった菓子がもとといわれる。長崎では、いまも小さな店が焼き続けている。岩永梅寿軒は1830年の創業で、焼いたカステラを一晩寝かせる。
industries._src: Sugar, egg, and flour baking introduced via Portuguese trade evolved in Nagasaki into hand-baked castella and sugar confections still made by small single-shop workshops.

industries.ja: 長崎びいどろ・ガラス工芸
industries.about: Records of the Nagasaki magistrate show vidro blowers in the town by 1670, and Nagasaki glass became a local speciality. The line stopped after the war. Today studios such as Rurian blow vidro by hand again.
industries.aboutJa: 長崎奉行の記録に、1670年にはびいどろ吹きが長崎にいたと残る。長崎ガラスは名産になったが、戦後に一度途絶えた。いまは瑠璃庵のような工房が、びいどろを手で吹いている。
industries._src: Blown glass (vidro) and church stained-glass techniques entered Japan through Nagasaki's port and continue in local glassblowing and stained-glass studios.

岩永梅寿軒.what: 天保元年（1830年）創業の和菓子店で、「寒菊」「もしほ草」の本家。カステラは焼いたあと一晩寝かせる。営業は月・水・金・土曜の10時から16時で、時期により変わる。
岩永梅寿軒.whatEn: A wagashi shop open since 1830, home of the sweets Kankiku and Moshiogusa. Its castella is baked and then rested overnight. Open Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, 10 am to 4 pm, with changes by season.
岩永梅寿軒.note: カステラは、店先に出ない日もある。行く前に営業の案内を見る。
岩永梅寿軒.noteEn: Some days there is no castella at the counter. Check the opening notice before you go.

_src.nameKana: いわながばいじゅけん
_src.whatJa: 天保元年（1830年）創業、本店1店舗のみで職人が手焼きする長崎カステラと伝統和菓子の老舗。
_src.whatEn: Single-shop traditional confectionery founded in 1830, known for small-batch hand-baked Nagasaki castella and seasonal wagashi.
_src.facts: Founded in Tenpo 1 (1830) and operates only its historic Suwa-machi shop with no department-store branches. Its Nagasaki castella is baked in small daily batches and rested overnight for a moist, elastic crumb, alongside house specialties like Kankiku and Moshiogusa.
_src.quote: 月・水・金・土曜日に営業致しますが、一部変更がございます。 8/5（水）、8/26（水）は店休予定日です。
_src.fixes: Castella over-the-counter sales were paused 10/30 to about 11/6, 2026 (temporary). Site says 創業天保元年, 寒菊・もしほ草本家. Address not re-verified (page text had no 諏訪町 match).

瑠璃庵.what: 大浦天主堂の近くにある、長崎びいどろの工房。原料の調合から吹きガラスまでを自分たちで行い、ステンドグラスも作る。9時半から17時で、火曜は休み。
瑠璃庵.whatEn: A studio for Nagasaki vidro near Oura Cathedral. They mix the glass, design and blow it themselves, and also make stained glass. Open 9:30 am to 5 pm, closed on Tuesdays.
瑠璃庵.note: 大浦天主堂電停から歩いて3分。火曜は休み。
瑠璃庵.noteEn: Three minutes on foot from Oura Cathedral tram stop. Closed on Tuesdays.

_src.whatJa: 大浦天主堂近くに工房を構え、長崎びいどろの吹きガラス器やステンドグラスを制作・販売するガラス工房。
_src.whatEn: Glassblowing and stained-glass workshop near Oura Cathedral producing traditional Nagasaki vidro vessels and architectural stained glass.
_src.facts: Craftsmen mix raw glass materials and blow pieces in-house, reviving Edo-period Nagasaki vidro forms such as Nagasaki Chirori sake decanters and poppen glass toys. The studio also handled restoration work on the stained glass of National Treasure Oura Cathedral and offers glassblowing and stained-glass workshops.
_src.quote: シルバーウィーク期間、9月19日(土)〜9月23日(水) は毎日開館いたします。 通常、火曜定休ですが9月22日(火)を特別営業、24日(木)を代休とさせていただきます。

長崎雑貨 たてまつる.what: 長崎奉行所の西役所があった江戸町の店。長崎の四季や風景、歴史を描いた手ぬぐい「たてま手ぬ」を作って売る。10時から18時半で、火曜は休み。
長崎雑貨 たてまつる.whatEn: A shop on Edo-machi, where the Nagasaki magistrate’s western office once stood. It makes and sells tenugui hand towels printed with the seasons, views and history of Nagasaki. Open 10 am to 6:30 pm, closed on Tuesdays.
長崎雑貨 たてまつる.note: 手ぬぐいは、絵に込めた話を読んでから選ぶ。
長崎雑貨 たてまつる.noteEn: Read the story behind a tenugui design before you choose.

_src.nameKana: ながさきざっか たてまつる
_src.whatJa: 江戸町の築70年の古民家で、オリジナル手ぬぐい「たてま手ぬ」や地元作家の陶器・箸置きを扱うクラフト雑貨店。
_src.whatEn: Craft and textile shop in a 70-year-old Edo-machi townhouse offering original hand-dyed tenugui cloths and ceramics by Nagasaki potters.
_src.facts: Located on the historic Edo-machi street where the Edo-period Nagasaki Magistrate's Western Office once stood, just north of Dejima. Designs original chusen-dyed tenugui textiles depicting Nagasaki's seasons alongside small-batch ceramic tableware and chopstick rests.
_src.fixes: Site shows no street address in text I read; Edo-machi address not confirmed on page.

珈琲人町.what: 東古川町のししとき川通りにある珈琲店。朝の珈琲教室も開く。11時から18時で、月曜は休み。
珈琲人町.whatEn: A coffee shop on Shishitoki River street in Higashifurukawa-machi. It also holds morning coffee classes. Open 11 am to 6 pm, closed on Mondays.
珈琲人町.note: 朝の珈琲教室の日程は、お知らせに出る。月曜は休み。
珈琲人町.noteEn: The dates of the morning coffee classes are in the news. Closed on Mondays.

_src.whatJa: 眼鏡橋近くの東古川町・ししとき川通りの路地に佇む、ハンドドリップ珈琲と自家製菓子の専門店。
_src.whatEn: Quiet alley-side specialty coffee shop along old Shishitoki River lane near Meganebashi, pouring hand-dripped coffee and house sweets.
_src.facts: Tucked on the ground floor along historic Shishitoki River lane in Higashifurukawa-machi, a short walk from Nakashima River. Brews carefully selected specialty beans to order in a calm wooden interior frequented by neighborhood regulars.
_src.quote: 2026.09.28 / コーヒー教室 ADACOFFEE 2026 席のご予約承ります！
_src.fixes: Address 長崎市東古川町4-25-1F matches. Hours 11:00-18:00, closed Mondays.

Museum Cafe 南山手八番館.what: グラバー園の入口前にあるレンガ造りの建物の喫茶。長崎南山手美術館に併設され、自家焙煎の珈琲やカステラアイスを出す。10時から16時で、木曜と毎月1日・16日は休み。
Museum Cafe 南山手八番館.whatEn: A cafe in the brick building in front of the Glover Garden entrance, attached to the Nagasaki Minamiyamate Museum. House-roasted coffee and castella ice cream. Open 10 am to 4 pm, closed on Thursdays and on the 1st and 16th of each month.
Museum Cafe 南山手八番館.note: 「幕末コーヒー」という一杯がある。まず、それを。
Museum Cafe 南山手八番館.noteEn: There is a cup called Bakumatsu Coffee. Start with that.

_src.nameKana: ミュージアムカフェ みなみやまてはちばんかん
_src.whatJa: グラバー園入口前の赤レンガ館・長崎南山手美術館に併設された、自家焙煎珈琲を楽しめる喫茶室。
_src.whatEn: Quiet cafe inside a red-brick art gallery right below Glover Garden, serving house-roasted drip coffee with views toward Nagasaki Harbor.
_src.facts: Located inside the brick Nagasaki Minamiyamate Museum building on the former Lot 8 of the Minamiyamate foreign settlement. Serves house-roasted coffee (also sold as original drip bags) and castella ice cream alongside local paintings and crafts.
_src.quote: 2026/10/31 「貸画廊」ページに、 ≪carillon 作品展≫ の紹介を追加しました。
_src.fixes: Cafe is 喫茶「Museum Cafe 南山手八番館」 attached to the museum; take-out coffee and castella ice cream confirmed.

ニューヨーク堂.what: 昭和12年（1937年）開業の洋菓子店で、店はここ1軒だけ。カステラでアイスをはさんだ「長崎カステラアイス」が名物。11時から16時で、休みは月ごとに公式サイトに出る。
ニューヨーク堂.whatEn: A confectioner open since 1937, with this one shop only. Its speciality is Nagasaki castella ice cream, ice cream between slices of castella. Open 11 am to 4 pm, with the closing days posted monthly on the official site.
ニューヨーク堂.note: 休みは月ごとに変わる。行く日を、公式サイトで確かめる。
ニューヨーク堂.noteEn: The closing days change every month. Check the official site for your day.

_src.whatJa: 昭和12年（1937年）創業、自家焼きカステラで手作りアイスを挟む「長崎カステラアイス」で知られる古川町の洋菓子店。
_src.whatEn: Confectionery shop founded in 1937 near Nakashima River, famous for ice cream sandwiched between slices of house-baked Nagasaki castella.
_src.facts: Opened in 1937 in Furukawa-machi and operates only this single shop attached to its small factory. Both the zarame-crusted castella sponge and the ice cream are made in-house by dedicated craftsmen, alongside freshly spun castella soft-serve.
_src.fixes: Page says 昭和１２年開業、創業８９年目; 眼鏡橋から徒歩３分; store hours 11:00-16:00. Address not shown on top page.

吉宗.what: 慶応2年（1866年）創業の、茶碗むしと蒸寿しの店。丼の大きさの茶碗むしに蒸寿しを添えた「夫婦蒸し」が名物。本店は昭和2年に建った建物で、火曜は休み。
吉宗.whatEn: A restaurant open since 1866, known for chawanmushi and steamed sushi. Its speciality, Meoto-mushi, is a bowl-sized chawanmushi served with steamed sushi. The main shop is in a building put up in 1927. Closed on Tuesdays.
吉宗.note: 茶碗むしは丼の大きさ。ほかの料理は控えめに。
吉宗.noteEn: The chawanmushi comes in a bowl. Order lightly for the rest.

_src.whatJa: 慶応2年（1866年）創業、名物の「茶碗むし」と「蒸寿し」の夫婦蒸しで親しまれる浜町の老舗料理店。
_src.whatEn: Historic dining hall founded in 1866 in Hamamachi, celebrated for its paired bowls of silky chawanmushi savory custard and steamed sushi.
_src.facts: Founded in 1866 and preserves a classic wooden facade with tatami and table seating in its Hamamachi flagship (plus one nearby takeout counter). Its signature Meoto-mushi pairs a large dashi-rich chawanmushi packed with nine ingredients alongside warm vinegared mushizushi topped with shredded egg and eel.
_src.quote: 【物産展】2026年11月18日(水)～24日(火) 『バナナマンのせっかくグルメ！！博覧会』
_src.fixes: Page confirms 慶応二年(1866年) founding, 茶碗むし・蒸寿し; note it says founded in 万屋町 (moved later); flagship 浜町本店, plus 観光通り店 takeout.

bistro ボルドー.what: 浜町のビストロ。トルコライスの原型を考えたというシェフの父の味を受け継ぎ、トルコライスを看板に、フレンチや創作料理も出す。11時から23時。
bistro ボルドー.whatEn: A bistro in Hamamachi. The chef carries on the Toruko rice of his father, who devised its original form, and serves it alongside French and creative dishes. Open 11 am to 11 pm.
bistro ボルドー.note: トルコライスは、昼にも夜にもある。ランチは17時まで。
bistro ボルドー.noteEn: Toruko rice is on at lunch and at dinner. Lunch runs until 5 pm.

_src.nameKana: ビストロ ボルドー
_src.whatJa: 浜町で親子二代にわたり愛される、本格フレンチの技法で作る名物トルコライスと洋食の老舗ビストロ。
_src.whatEn: Long-running French-trained bistro in Hamamachi known as a pioneer of Nagasaki's Toruko Rice plate and casual bistro lunches.
_src.facts: Single-location bistro tracing its Toruko Rice roots back over six decades to the current chef's father. Combines pork cutlet, demi-glace sauce, Neapolitan spaghetti, and saffron-butter pilaf on one plate alongside French bistro courses.
_src.quote: 5月31日（日）、長崎浜市商店街で行われた 長崎ヴェルカ B1優勝記念パレード。
_src.fixes: Page: 60数年前に料理長の父が考案したトルコライス, open daily 11:00-23:00. Site news section itself is stale (2024).

sights.name: 出島
sights.what: 南蛮貿易の時代の1636年に完成し、のちにオランダ商館が置かれた島。19世紀初頭の姿を目指す復元整備で、カピタン部屋など16棟が復元されている。
sights.whatEn: The island completed in 1636, in the time of the Nanban trade, and later the site of the Dutch trading post. A restoration aimed at the early nineteenth century has rebuilt 16 buildings, including the Capitan’s room.
sights.notice: 旧出島神学校は、安全のため入室できない。観覧は8時から21時（最終入場20時40分）で、年中無休。
sights.noticeEn: The old Dejima seminary is closed to entry for safety reasons. Open 8 am to 9 pm (last entry 8:40 pm), every day of the year.

sights.name: グラバー園
sights.what: 旧グラバー住宅を中心に、長崎市内の古い洋風建築を移築復元した庭園。旧グラバー住宅は世界遺産の構成資産で、3棟が国の重要文化財。
sights.whatEn: A garden of Meiji-era Western-style buildings moved and rebuilt around the former Glover House, a World Heritage component. Three of the buildings are national Important Cultural Properties.
sights.notice: 旧オルト住宅は保存修理工事のため観覧できない（再開は2027年3月の予定）。11月と12月は20時まで開園。
sights.noticeEn: The former Alt House is closed for repair works (reopening planned for March 2027). Open until 8 pm in November and December.

sights.name: 眼鏡橋
sights.what: 1634年に興福寺の唐僧・黙子如定が架けた、日本で最初のアーチ型の石橋。国の重要文化財で、中島川の石橋群の一つ。1982年の大水害で半壊し、1983年に復元された。
sights.whatEn: The first arched stone bridge in Japan, built in 1634 by Mokushi Nyojo, a Chinese monk of Kofukuji temple. A national Important Cultural Property over the Nakashima River. It was half destroyed in the 1982 flood and rebuilt in 1983.

sights.name: 長崎歴史文化博物館
sights.nameEn: Nagasaki Museum of History and Culture
sights.what: 長崎の歴史と文化を伝える博物館。常設展に、歴史文化展示ゾーンと、町屋、長崎奉行所ゾーンがある。
sights.whatEn: A museum of the history and culture of Nagasaki. Its permanent exhibition has a history and culture zone, a machiya townhouse and a zone on the Nagasaki magistrate’s office.
sights.notice: 休館日は毎月第1・第3月曜（祝日の場合は翌平日）。11月は16日が休館で、19時まで開館（最終入館18時30分）。
sights.noticeEn: Closed on the first and third Mondays of each month (the next weekday if a holiday). In November it is closed on the 16th, and open until 7 pm (last entry 6:30 pm).
